simple.meaning: אַוָּה (ʼavvâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “longing.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: אַוָּה (H185) appears 7 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Deuteronomy 12:15, with occurrences in Deuteronomy, 1 Samuel, Jeremiah, Hosea.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אַוָּה (H185) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in אַוָּה (H185) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: אַוָּה (ʼavvâh) / H185 is traced through Deuteronomy 12:15, Deuteronomy 12:20, Deuteronomy 12:21, Deuteronomy 18:6 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H185. avvah [ אַוָּה ] noun feminine desire — construct אַוַּת Deut 12:15 5 t.; suffix אַוָּתִי Hosea 10:10 — desire, will , usually followed by נֶפֶשׁ ; of natural human desire (morally indifferent), for meat Deut 12:15 , 20 , 21 ; of longing for sanctuary 18:6 ; of royal good pleasure 1Sam 23:20 ; without נֶפֶשׁ , of wild-ass Jer 2:24 ; of divine will Hosea 10:10 .

occurrences.englishText: Yet you may kill and eat meat within all your gates, after all the desire of your soul, according to Yahweh your God’s blessing which he has given you. The unclean and the clean may eat of it, as of the gazelle and the deer.
When Yahweh your God enlarges your border, as he has promised you, and you say, “I want to eat meat,” because your soul desires to eat meat, you may eat meat, after all the desire of your soul.

If the place which Yahweh your God shall choose to put his name is too far from you, then you shall kill of your herd and of your flock, which Yahweh has given you, as I have commanded you; and you may eat within your gates, after all the desire of your soul.
If a Levite comes from any of your gates out of all Israel where he lives, and comes with all the desire of his soul to the place which Yahweh shall choose,
Now therefore, O king, come down. According to all the desire of your soul to come down; and our part will be to deliver him up into the king’s hand.”
